Authority, Vijaypura, In L.A.C.No.1122/2019, And To
Determine Market Value Of The Appellant Land At
Rs.32,550/- Per Gunta With All Statutory Benefits In
The Interest Of Justice And Equity.

This Appeal Coming On For Orders This Day,
B.M.Shyam Prasad J., Delivered The Following:
 Judgment
Sri Sanganabasava B. Patil, the learned counsel for the appellant, relying upon memo dated 12.07.2023, submits that he may be granted leave to withdraw the appeal.
He also submits that he has received instructions in this regard from his counterpart who has entrusted the brief.

Further,
while inviting this Court's attention to the previous order dated 07.07.2023, he submits that the cost imposed may be waived.
In the peculiarities of the case, the cost is waived and the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
